subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Our situation is more better than that of our contemporaries right now.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the term "**more better**" which is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The word "**better**" itself is the comparative form of "good," so adding "**more**" is redundant.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**better**," ensuring** grammatical correctness **and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Our situation is** better** than that of our contemporaries right now."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.
 
• **Option 3: than that of our** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: contemporaries right now.** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
